title: Filter the list by done
goal: Clients can ask for open or finished items only, instead of filtering the whole list themselves.

acceptance_criteria.text: GET /todos?done=true returns only finished items and GET /todos?done=false only open ones.
Any other value of done is refused with 400; GET /todos without it still returns every item.

context.notes: Keep node:http only; no dependencies. Add tests for every acceptance criterion.
